propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107+ emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when infer_model receives the ambiguous openai: prefix, announcing that v2 will reinterpret it from Chat Completions to Responses.
rebar's _pai_model and model-class _resolve_target compose and emit the ambiguous openai: target, causing deprecation warnings at runtime in real OpenAI-compatible provider tests.
Normalizing all inferred and explicit openai: targets to the stable openai-chat: qualifier preserves Chat Completions semantics and eliminates the v2 deprecation warning.

ProviderSession must recognize both openai and openai-chat provider names in its cfg.base_url builder registration and per-candidate endpoint-override gates to preserve custom-endpoint routing after target normalization.
User approved Chat Completions preservation (openai-chat:) as the compatibility-preserving choice; migration to openai-responses: is deferred to a separate story.
